definitions.transitions: rows=original q, columns=round(saved z); row triples=[from,to,count], including nonzero diagonal
definitions.entropy: sum of per-matrix code lengths; global probabilities are element-weighted marginals
definitions.soft_accounting: FP32 softmax assignments; FP64 mass reductions; log probability clamp=1e-12
definitions.trainer_soft_entropy: original frozen FP32 formula; H_gradients always differentiate 2*H/FULL_TARGETS
definitions.row_entropy_delta: exact per-symbol loss secants along linear aggregate mass interpolation, dotted with each row mass delta
definitions.dot: dot of the weighted positive H gradient with saved z-original q or hard q-original q; positive is local H ascent
definitions.cosine: dot/(gradient l2 * displacement l2); null for a zero norm
definitions.encoded_W: hard q times original signed BF16 scale; static15 framing and finite-precision coder bytes are measured separately
definitions.hard_weighted_delta: hard entropy times 2/FULL_TARGETS is a diagnostic proxy; the frozen objective uses soft H
definitions.row_selection: every hard-changed row and tiny-scale row, plus global top contributors; fractional-only remainder stays in sums
definitions.ranking: largest absolute contribution, retaining signed values; exact zero excluded

format_note: First numerical run preserved; changed_z_rows labels all rows with z movement, fractional_only_rows subtracts hard-changed rows. Formula and numerical values stay fixed.
